tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

Mark the start of a new chapter in this session.

Call this when the work shifts to a meaningfully different phase — e.g. after finishing exploration and starting implementation, after a fix lands and you move to verification, or when the user pivots to an unrelated request. tools.name: mcp__ccd_turn__update_plan
tools.description:
Keep the task list the app shows under your latest message while you work. Every request that edits files or runs more than one command gets one (implement-and-test, investigate-then-fix, anything the user listed); only a single-command answer or pure conversation does not.

Never spend a message on this tool alone: send it IN THE SAME MESSAGE as another tool call (in parallel), so it costs no extra round trip.
- First call: with the VERY FIRST tool call of the turn, even one that only reads or lists files: {"items": [...]}, the whole plan in order, short imperative phrases (at most ~7 words, no numbering), the step you are starting "in_progress", the rest "pending". If you must look around first, make "Look at how X is set up" step one and refine the list once you know.
- Next step: {"advance": true} alongside the call that begins it (completes the in_progress step, starts the next pending one); after the last step, advance alongside wrap_up.
- Out of order: {"done": [2], "start": 4} (1-based).
- Plan changed, including right after the user interrupts or sends a new instruction mid-task: {"items": [...]} again, the new whole list, so the pinned list never shows an abandoned plan.
- Every {"items"} call says in "scope" what this request is to the session: "first_task" (nothing finished here yet); after that, "new_task" (unrelated work: it builds on nothing done, found or decided here) or "continuation" (everything else: anything a few tool calls settle, the next iteration, acting on what you just investigated or suggested, even if that work gets its own commit or PR; when unsure, this one). A "new_task" turn opens with a start_session offer and reaches this call only if the user chose Do it here.
Keep exactly one step in_progress while working and none when everything is done. Do not also write the plan as a numbered list in your message: the pinned list is the plan.

tools.name: mcp__ccd_turn__wrap_up
tools.description:
Fill the "next step" box the app shows at the end of your turn: a two-or-three-sentence recap and, when this turn leaves the user a decision to make or a step to take, one question and buttons that answer it; a turn with nothing pending ends with the recap alone, and the app then draws no box. Call it once in EVERY turn in which you kept a task list, changed files, ran commands, or completed multi-step work: when this turn's work is done, before any closing message (it also checks off the task list; no closing update_plan is needed). Skip it for short answers, pure conversation, or a brief read-and-explain turn — a reply that names a follow-up is not brief: propose it and call this.

The result says which case below applies. When the box shows your question, it ends your turn: write no text after this call, since the recap and question say what the user needs and your work above holds the detail. Otherwise your closing message is ordinary text right after this call, the last thing you say this turn: your answer to the user in full, with any question the box did not show.

Fields — recap and ask are said to the user, in the second person; a reply button's label and message are the user's words back to you:
- recap: what is now true or changed, then where it stands, including what is not done or not verified (for example: nothing committed, or not checked in the app). Two or three short sentences, about 40 words / 300 characters, in the project's own words. No recommendation here.
- ask (with actions, only when the next move is the user's call — a choice of approach, a go-ahead to commit, push, post or send, an approval): just that ONE decision in one short sentence, never two joined by "and" ("Which fix first?"), with no reason or recommendation and without listing the options the buttons give: your pick, actions[0], is drawn as the primary button. At most 100 characters.
Every field is a top-level parameter holding plain prose (actions: a JSON array); none contains markup or another field.

recap.description: Two or three short sentences to the user (≤300 chars): what is now true or changed, then where it stands, including what is not done or not verified. Its first sentence is the sidebar status.

ask.description: The one question (≤100 chars) when the next move is the user's call — a choice, a go-ahead, an approval: the decision alone, with no reason or recommendation and without listing the options the buttons give (actions[0] is your pick). Omit it, and actions, when nothing waits on the user.

blocked.description: true when your work stops here until the user answers (the app marks the session as waiting on them); omit when the answer can wait.

action.description: An app action update_plan's result listed as available now, or one your own work this turn made available; anything else is refused, and one that stops being available later is dropped (as actions[0], with your ask and the other answers), so do not guess. Omit for a reply.

label.description: For a reply: the button text, 1–3 words (4 only when three cannot say it) / 24 characters — "Yes, fix 1", "Fix 2 instead", "Not now": a button, not a sentence; the detail goes in message. No "@", no leading / or !. Ignored for an app action (the app's own label is used).

message.description: For a reply: what the click sends, up to 300 characters of plain text — no "@" anywhere, no leading / or !. Omit when the label is the whole message.

actions.description: 1–2 buttons, recommendation first. They are answers to your ask: the first accepts your recommendation, and another is there only when it is a realistic alternative the user might pick instead — not a menu of everything you mentioned. When blocked is true, they are the most likely answers to your question. While Auto-fix is on for the session's PR, none offers to watch it, fix CI, resolve conflicts or address comments.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__browser_batch
tools.description: Execute a sequence of Browser pane tool calls in ONE round trip. Each item is {name, input} where input is exactly what you'd pass to that tool standalone. Actions execute SEQUENTIALLY (not in parallel) and stop on the first error. Use this tool extensively to quickly execute work whenever you can predict two or more steps ahead — e.g. navigate, click a field, type, press Return, screenshot. Each tool's own permission check runs per item — a step on a site the user hasn't allowed either asks the user inline (and continues if they allow) or is refused, which stops the batch; if a step is refused for a missing permission, call that tool on its own (that call can ask the user), then batch the rest. Screenshots and other images are returned interleaved with outputs; coordinates you write in THIS batch refer to the screenshot taken BEFORE this call. browser_batch cannot be nested, and preview_start is not batchable — but if the Browser pane isn't open yet, a batch whose FIRST action is navigate with a url opens it (other actions still need an open page).

input.description: That tool's input — same shape you'd pass when calling it directly. tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
tools.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

schema.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
schema.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

tabId.description: Tab to act on within the preview context. Omit for the fronted tab; get ids from tabs_context.

action.description:
The action to perform:
* `left_click`: Click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `right_click`: Click the right mouse button at the specified coordinates to open context menus.
* `double_click`: Double-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `triple_click`: Triple-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `type`: Type a string of text.
* `screenshot`: Take a screenshot of the screen.
* `wait`: Wait for a specified number of seconds.
* `scroll`: Scroll up, down, left, or right at the specified coordinates.
* `key`: Press a specific keyboard key.
* `left_click_drag`: Drag from start_coordinate to coordinate.
* `zoom`: Take a screenshot of a specific region for closer inspection.
* `scroll_to`: Scroll an element into view using its element reference ID from read_page or find tools.
* `hover`: Move the mouse cursor to the specified coordinates or element without clicking. Useful for revealing tooltips, dropdown menus, or triggering hover states.

coordinate.description: (x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates. Required for `left_click`, `right_click`, `double_click`, `triple_click`, and `scroll`. For `left_click_drag`, this is the end position.

text.description: The text to type (for `type` action) or the key(s) to press (for `key` action). For `key` action: Provide space-separated keys (e.g., "Backspace Backspace Delete"). action.description: What to do. 'attach' opens the live simulator panel for the user — call it BEFORE you build or launch, as soon as the user wants to see the app: on a booted simulator it opens immediately, and otherwise it returns a clear, harmless error (boot or build first, then retry it). Do not skip the early attach because 'launch' also attaches — the panel should be open before the build starts. The panel is the user's view, not a precondition — 'screenshot' and input actions work without it. Skip it only when the user has no interest in watching; 'launch' installs and launches an .app (it also re-attaches, but call 'attach' early rather than relying on that); 'screenshot' returns a PNG of the current screen; 'tap'/'swipe'/'text'/'button' inject input; 'touch_path' performs a single-finger drag along an arbitrary path (eased curves, long-press-then-drag); 'touch2_path' is the two-finger variant for pinch/rotate; 'open_url' opens a deep link; 'detach' closes the panel/stream. NOTE: a 'swipe' or 'touch_path' whose start point is on-screen and within 4pt of an edge performs the OS edge gesture instead of a plain drag — left=back, top=notification shade, bottom=home/app-switcher, right=Control Center (mapped to the current interface orientation). `[pause]`, `[short pause]`, `[slowly]` (para o placar), `[sighs]` (ressalva), `[clears throat]` (abertura, uma vez).
Reticências criam pausa curta; quebra de linha é um respiro maior; CAIXA ALTA dá ênfase a UM número por bloco.
Números por extenso quando a locução ganha ("cinquenta vírgula sete por cento", "quatro milhões e cem mil").
Sem travessão, sem hashtag, sem adjetivo decorativo. Abertura com hora; fecho com a leitura de analista.
Entre 500 e 600 palavras (3 a 4 minutos no v4, que fala pausado; 788 palavras deram 5 min 17 s). Arquivo: data/boletins/HHMM.txt, depois scripts/boletim-falar.sh (API direta por parágrafo, ffmpeg concat, afplay). Nunca o sag para boletins longos.

## Regras de leitura (desde 21:15 de 04/10)
- Senado: cada UF elege DOIS senadores; os dois mais votados entram, não disputam entre si. Dizer "os dois prováveis eleitos são X e Y" e, quando `segunda_vaga_apertada`, quem ameaça a segunda vaga e por quantos pontos. Nunca "X lidera a disputa contra Y" quando os dois estão nas duas vagas.
- Desde 22:40 de 04/10: NÃO falar de vão estadual, puxar voto ou transferência. O bloco estratégico é o tamanho das bancadas (JSON BANCADAS): Câmara por espectro e por partido, Senado de 2027, assembleias dos principais estados, governadores eleitos e segundos turnos, e o que isso significa para governabilidade.
- Governadores: separar "eleito no primeiro turno" (TSE marca) de "acima de cinquenta por cento com apuração parcial" e de "vai ao segundo turno".

## Fase final (desde 22:15 de 04/10, apuração acima de 99%)
- Não falar mais de atraso de leitura, arquivo atrasado, CDN ou cópia antiga. O assunto é resultado e o que ele significa.
- Fechar cada boletim com o quadro que se consolida: segundo turno presidencial com os dois nomes e a distância; governadores eleitos no primeiro turno (só os que o TSE marcou) e os pares do segundo turno; bancadas em formação.

content.text: Enquanto os dois agentes de planejamento trabalham, três decisões são suas e mudam o desenho:

questions.question: Como gerar os clipes ilustrativos (sopa, concha, seção de votação, fila)? A chave Gemini existe em PNAD/.env e o Veo 3.1 roda por API em 16:9 e 9:16, mas é pago (na faixa de US$ 1 a 3 por clipe de 8 s; uns 15 clipes nos dois formatos dá algo entre US$ 30 e 90).

options.label: API Veo primeiro (Recomendado)
options.description: Script com manifesto de prompts e cache por hash; se a chave não tiver faturamento, caio para o navegador (Gemini web / CapCut Seedance) com a mesma convenção de nomes.

options.label: Só navegador
options.description: Gero os clipes pelo gemini.google.com e CapCut no navegador embutido, um a um, e salvo com os nomes do manifesto. Mais lento e manual, sem custo de API.

options.label: Sem vídeo IA
options.description: Tudo animado em Remotion (SVG/Canvas) mais imagens fixas locais do mflux. Mais controle e zero custo, menos cinema.

questions.question: Qual duração mirar de saída? O conteúdo pedido é denso (sopa, pesquisas × urna, house effect, contagem pública, fiscais, totalização, riscos com exemplos reais, mapa, Milei). Em 145 palavras por minuto, 12 min são cerca de 1.750 palavras.

options.label: 12 min com lista de cortes (Recomendado)
options.description: Roteiro em 1.700 a 1.800 palavras com cenas marcadas como 'cortável'; se a narração gravada passar de 12:30, promovo a versão para 14 a 15 min em vez de ficar em 13.

options.label: Mirar 14 a 15 min direto
options.description: Roteiro em 2.050 a 2.150 palavras, com mais exemplos de seção e mais tempo no mapa. Sem correr o risco de cortar o que importa.

## 3. Legal/procedural facts the masterclass must state exactly (all "verify")

The dossier already asserts most of these (`analysis/apuracao_2026/fiscais.md` lines 213-219, sourced to search-result reproductions, not planalto.gov.br). Re-source each against planalto.gov.br / tse.jus.br before writing.

- **Código Eleitoral (Lei 4.737/1965) art. 131** (verify): each party may nominate delegados per município and fiscais per mesa receptora; confirm the numbers (repo does not state them) and credential rules.
- **CE art. 132** (verify wording): before the mesas receptoras, candidates, delegados and fiscais may fiscalizar a votação, formular protestos e fazer impugnações, inclusive sobre a identidade do eleitor.
- **Lei 9.504/1997 art. 65** (verify): fiscal must be over 18 and not a mesário; §1 one fiscal may cover more than one section in the same local de votação; §2 credentials issued by the party; §4 at most 2 fiscais per party per section. This is the legal basis of 03-bangu.
- **Art. 66** (verify): parties may fiscalizar all phases of voting and apuração.
- **Art. 68 §1** (verify exact wording): presidente da mesa delivers a copy of the BU to the party that requests it, "até uma hora após a expedição" per the repo; confirm current text and whether there is a penalty paragraph.
- **Art. 39 §5** (verify incisos and penalty): crimes on election day, including arregimentação de eleitor and boca de urna (inciso II); detenção 6 meses a 1 ano plus multa per the 1st-round page. **Art. 39-A**: individual silent manifestation permitted; restrictions on vestuário for mesários and fiscais (verify).
- **Art. 41-A** (optional, only if a case needs it): captação ilícita de sufrágio.
- **Res. TSE 23.611/2019** (verify): articles on fiscais and delegados, credenciamento, access to zerésima and to the BU.
- **Who to report to** (verify each): ocorrência na ata with the presidente da mesa; juiz eleitoral da zona; Ministério Público Eleitoral (promotor eleitoral); Pardal app; Disque 100 likely out.
- **What the fiscal never does** (verify against resolution): touch the urna, interfere with the vote, film the voter voting, campaign inside the section.

Rule for the script: every one of these lines is spoken as "a lei diz" only after the planalto text is in `fontes_fiscais.json` with URL and date.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Narração, efeitos e trilha do vídeo dos fiscais (video/fiscais), pela API do ElevenLabs.

Lê `video/fiscais/roteiro/roteiro.md` (um bloco `## id` por cena), gera cada cena na voz do
Leonardo (modelo eleven_v4, com `previous_text`/`next_text` para a prosódia emendar, como em
`apuracao/scripts/boletim-tts.py`) pelo endpoint com carimbo de tempo por caractere, e grava:

- `video/fiscais/public/voz/<id>.mp3`
- `video/fiscais/src/dados/voz.json`: cena, arquivo, duração em segundos (ffprobe), texto sem
  tags e palavras com início e fim, para as legendas.
- `video/fiscais/public/sfx/*.mp3`: efeitos curtos (sound-generation) e trilha instrumental
  (music), só quando o arquivo ainda não existe.

Chave e voz vêm de `~/arvor/voicer/.env`. Uso:
  python3 scripts/video-fiscais-voz.py            # tudo o que falta
  python3 scripts/video-fiscais-voz.py --so c-a   # regera uma cena
  python3 scripts/video-fiscais-voz.py --forcar   # regera todas as cenas
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import base64
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import urllib.request
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
VIDEO = ROOT / "video" / "fiscais"
ROTEIRO = VIDEO / "roteiro" / "roteiro.md"
VOZ_DIR = VIDEO / "public" / "voz"
SFX_DIR = VIDEO / "public" / "sfx"
VOZ_JSON = VIDEO / "src" / "dados" / "voz.json"
ENV = Path.home() / "arvor" / "voicer" / ".env"

MODELO = "eleven_v4"
AJUSTES = {
    "stability": 0.4,
    "similarity_boost": 0.8,
    "style": 0.3,
    "use_speaker_boost": True,
}
PARALELO = 4
TAG = re.compile(r"\[[a-z ]+\]")

EFEITOS = {
    "whoosh": ("fast cinematic whoosh transition, clean, short", 0.9),
    "blip": ("short digital UI blip, soft synth click, clean", 0.5),
    "stamp": ("heavy stamp impact hit with short low thud, cinematic", 0.8),
    "scan": ("sci-fi radar scanner sweep, soft rising synth, short", 1.6),
    "chime": ("soft success chime, two notes, warm synth", 1.2),
}
TRILHA = (
    "Tense, modern, minimal electronic underscore for a civic data documentary; "
    "pulsing synth bass, soft electronic percussion, subtle strings, hopeful build, "
    "instrumental, no vocals, 110 bpm, loopable"
)
TRILHA_MS = 150_000


def ambiente() -> tuple[str, str]:
    chave = voz = ""
    for linha in ENV.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        if linha.startswith("ELEVENLABS_API_KEY="):
            chave = linha.split("=", 1)[1].strip().strip('"')
        elif linha.startswith("ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID="):
            voz = linha.split("=", 1)[1].strip().strip('"')
    if not chave or not voz:
        raise SystemExit(f"ELEVENLABS_API_KEY ou ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID ausentes em {ENV}")
    return chave, voz


def cenas(texto: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """Blocos `## id` do roteiro, na ordem, com o texto cru (tags incluídas)."""
    saida: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    atual: str | None = None
    corpo: list[str] = []
    for linha in texto.splitlines():
        if linha.startswith("## "):
            if atual:
                saida.append((atual, "\n".join(corpo).strip()))
            atual = linha[3:].strip()
            corpo = []
        elif atual is not None:
            corpo.append(linha)
    if atual:
        saida.append((atual, "\n".join(corpo).strip()))
    return saida


def limpar(texto: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", TAG.sub("", texto)).strip()


def pedido(url: str, chave: str, corpo: dict) -> bytes:
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        url,
        data=json.dumps(corpo).encode(),
        headers={"xi-api-key": chave, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
    )
    return urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=600).read()


def palavras_do_alinhamento(alinhamento: dict) -> list[dict]:
    """Agrupa caracteres em palavras e descarta as tags entre colchetes."""
    chars = alinhamento["characters"]
    ini = alinhamento["character_start_times_seconds"]

# OpenAI Image Gen

Generate a handful of “random but structured” prompts and render them via the OpenAI Images API.

## Run

```bash
python3 {baseDir}/scripts/gen.py
open ~/Projects/tmp/openai-image-gen-*/index.html  # if ~/Projects/tmp exists; else ./tmp/...
```

Useful flags:

```bash
# GPT image models with various options
python3 {baseDir}/scripts/gen.py --count 16 --model gpt-image-1
python3 {baseDir}/scripts/gen.py --prompt "ultra-detailed studio photo of a lobster astronaut" --count 4
python3 {baseDir}/scripts/gen.py --size 1536x1024 --quality high --out-dir ./out/images
python3 {baseDir}/scripts/gen.py --model gpt-image-1.5 --background transparent --output-format webp

# DALL-E 3 (note: count is automatically limited to 1)
python3 {baseDir}/scripts/gen.py --model dall-e-3 --quality hd --size 1792x1024 --style vivid
python3 {baseDir}/scripts/gen.py --model dall-e-3 --style natural --prompt "serene mountain landscape"

# DALL-E 2
python3 {baseDir}/scripts/gen.py --model dall-e-2 --size 512x512 --count 4
```

## Model-Specific Parameters

Different models support different parameter values. The script automatically selects appropriate defaults based on the model.

### Size

- **GPT image models** (`gpt-image-1`, `gpt-image-1-mini`, `gpt-image-1.5`): `1024x1024`, `1536x1024` (landscape), `1024x1536` (portrait), or `auto`
  - Default: `1024x1024`
- **dall-e-3**: `1024x1024`, `1792x1024`, or `1024x1792`
  - Default: `1024x1024`
- **dall-e-2**: `256x256`, `512x512`, or `1024x1024`
  - Default: `1024x1024`

### Quality

- **GPT image models**: `auto`, `high`, `medium`, or `low`
  - Default: `high`
- **dall-e-3**: `hd` or `standard`
  - Default: `standard`
- **dall-e-2**: `standard` only
  - Default: `standard`

### Other Notable Differences

- **dall-e-3** only supports generating 1 image at a time (`n=1`). The script automatically limits count to 1 when using this model.

## Model-Specific Parameters

Different models support different parameter values. The script automatically selects appropriate defaults based on the model.

### Size

- **GPT image models** (`gpt-image-1`, `gpt-image-1-mini`, `gpt-image-1.5`): `1024x1024`, `1536x1024` (landscape), `1024x1536` (portrait), or `auto`
  - Default: `1024x1024`
- **dall-e-3**: `1024x1024`, `1792x1024`, or `1024x1792`
  - Default: `1024x1024`
- **dall-e-2**: `256x256`, `512x512`, or `1024x1024`
  - Default: `1024x1024`

### Quality

- **GPT image models**: `auto`, `high`, `medium`, or `low`
  - Default: `high`
- **dall-e-3**: `hd` or `standard`
  - Default: `standard`
- **dall-e-2**: `standard` only
  - Default: `standard`

### Other Notable Differences

- **dall-e-3** only supports generating 1 image at a time (`n=1`). The script automatically limits count to 1 when using this model.

# Local Image Generation — FLUX 2 Klein 9B (mflux)

Gera imagens localmente no Mac, zero custo, zero API, totalmente offline.

## Comando base

```bash
PATH="$PATH:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin" ~/anaconda3/envs/diffusionkit/bin/mflux-generate-flux2 \
  --model flux2-klein-9b \
  --prompt "seu prompt em inglês" \
  --height 768 --width 1360 \
  --steps 4 \
  --quantize 4 \
  --output /tmp/diffusion-out/imagem.png \
  --seed 42
```

## Parâmetros essenciais

| Parâmetro | Valores | Uso |
|-----------|---------|-----|
| `--model` | `flux2-klein-9b` (padrão) / `flux2-klein-4b` (mais rápido) | 9b = qualidade, 4b = velocidade |
| `--quantize` | `3` `4` `5` `6` `8` | 4 = rápido (~20s), 8 = melhor qualidade (~60s) |
| `--steps` | `4` (padrão distilled) até `20` | mais steps = mais detalhe, mais lento |
| `--guidance` | float (ex: `3.5`) | controle de aderência ao prompt |
| `--width` / `--height` | pixels | resolução da imagem |
| `--seed` | integer | reprodutibilidade; `--auto-seeds 4` gera 4 aleatórios |

# Masterclass video: implementation plan

## 0. Facts verified during exploration that shape the design

- `video/fiscais/src/plano.ts` builds `CENAS` from `voz.json` and exposes `quadro/quadroDa/indiceDa`; `Video.tsx` is a switch; `HUD.tsx` hard-codes the tag and uses one progress segment per scene. All data-free components (`Caixa`, `Contador`, `Legenda`, `Fundo`, `Mapa`, `util.ts`, `tema.ts`, `formato.tsx`) have no dependency on `dados.json` except `Mapa` (takes `Dados["mapa"]` as a prop, fine).
- `tests/conftest.py` puts `scripts/` on `sys.path`; `test_video_fiscais.py` imports `video-fiscais-dados` via `importlib` and skips when `dados.json` is missing. Nothing in it references anything we will add, so it keeps passing as long as `video/fiscais` is untouched.
- Veo 3.1 REST (docs read today): `POST https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/veo-3.1-fast-generate-preview:predictLongRunning`, body `{"instances":[{"prompt"}],"parameters":{"aspectRatio":"16:9"|"9:16","resolution":"1080p","durationSeconds":"8","personGeneration":"allow_all"}}`; poll `GET /v1beta/{operation.name}` every ~10 s; download `response.generateVideoResponse.generatedSamples[0].video.uri` with header `x-goog-api-key`. 1080p requires 8 s. Videos expire after 2 days.
- ElevenLabs music: `music_length_ms` accepts 3 000 to 600 000 ms, plus `force_instrumental`. So one track per act up to 10 min is allowed; no need to loop.
- `docs/assets/fiscais_mapa/app.js`: hash keys `uf, mun, zona, cep, q, nivel, raio, camada, log, modo, l, s`; `window.fiscaisMapa = { estado: S, aplicarBusca, atualizar }`; `ZOOM_ROTULOS = 15` (section numbers drawn at zoom >= 15); mobile layout when `window.innerWidth < 980`. `S.aberto` holds the open building id.
- Map data for the two example buildings: `RJ-60011-233-1414` (EM Getúlio Vargas, Bangu, zona 233) has 12 listed sections (1 `baixa` + 11 log-only); `SP-71072-372-2020` (EE Amélia Kerr Nogueira, zona 372) has 13 (1 `baixa` + 12 log-only). `secoes_total` (column 14 of `locais`) carries the full building count (the 21 to 27 figure); the roteiro must cite what the data script emits.
- `docs/assets/totalizacao/app.js`: no camera headless, but `lerArquivos()` decodes images from `<input id="arquivo">`, so Playwright `set_input_files` with QR PNGs rendered from `totalizacao/tests/fixtures/exemplos_tse_2026.json` (`exemplos[i].qrbu[]`) reaches `#tela-conferir` without a camera. `qrcode` is installed in python3. Never click `#btn-enviar` (real backend).
- `docs/assets/politize/app.js` accepts `#l=<local_id>` and writes hash via `hashDo`.
- Income data: Datafolha `datafolha_2026-10-14` sample 48.33 % at ≤2 SM vs PNAD 35.19 % (= +13.1 pp, not +14 to +17); Quaest 31.0 vs 35.19 (= −4.2 pp). The roteiro must use the script output; the test will enforce it.
- `google-genai` and `playwright` import in python3; `~/arvor/voicer/.env` exists; `GEMINI_API_KEY` is in `PNAD/.env`.

## 1. Project layout: copy and generalize into `video/masterclass/`, no shared package yet

Recommendation: new project `video/masterclass/` created by copying `video/fiscais/` and generalizing inside it. Reasons: (a) fiscais must keep rendering and its test must pass; a workspace hoist would move `node_modules` and break `navegador.mjs`/`remotion.config.ts` relative paths; (b) a source-only `video/comum/` consumed via `Config.overrideWebpackConfig` + tsconfig paths adds a resolution risk one week before delivery; (c) the generalized modules below are written data-free so that extracting them to `video/comum/` later is a file move. Record that intent in `video/masterclass/README.md`.

Files (all under `/Users/leonardodias/arvor/PNAD/video/masterclass/`):

- Copied verbatim: `eslint.config.mjs`, `navegador.mjs`, `stills.mjs`, `tsconfig.json`, `remotion.config.ts`, `public/arvor_logo.png`, `public/sfx/*` (whoosh, blip, stamp, scan, chime; old trilha not copied), `src/index.ts`, `src/tema.ts`, `src/componentes/{Caixa,Contador,Fundo,Mapa,util}.ts(x)`.
- `package.json`: name `masterclass-video`, scripts `render:wide` → `MasterclassWide out/masterclass_16x9.mp4`, `render:vertical`, `stills`, `verificar` (see 2).
- New/modified: `src/Root.tsx` (ids `MasterclassWide`, `MasterclassVertical`), `src/Video.tsx` (registry dispatch, chapters, `Trilha`), `src/plano.ts` (+ chapters, + `narrando` array), `src/ordem.ts`, `src/capitulos.ts`, `src/cenas/registro.ts`, `src/formato.tsx` (+ `escala`), `src/componentes/{HUD,Legenda,Palco,Lado,Pilha,Clipe,Still,Cursor,Trilha,CartaoCapitulo}.tsx`, `src/graficos/{Eixo,BarrasInstitutos,Concha,PerfilTSE,PontosEfeitoCasa}.tsx`, `src/cenas/*.tsx` (one file per chapter), `src/tipos.ts` (new `Dados` type for `masterclass.json`), `src/dados/{voz,masterclass,midia}.json` (generated), `roteiro/roteiro.md`, `roteiro/fontes.md`, `midia/manifesto.json`, `midia/cache.json`, `midia/entrada/` (manual drop-in), `capturas/roteiro.json`, `.gitignore` (+ `public/midia/`, `public/voz/`, `midia/entrada/`, `capturas/bruto/`).

## 2. Scene and chapter model

```ts
export const ORDEM = [
  { id: "abertura", capitulo: "abertura" },
  { id: "cap-sopa", capitulo: "sopa" }, { id: "sopa-panela", capitulo: "sopa" }, { id: "sopa-concha", capitulo: "sopa" }, { id: "sopa-verdade", capitulo: "sopa" },
  { id: "cap-urna", capitulo: "urna" }, { id: "urna-resultado", ... }, { id: "urna-erro", ... }, { id: "urna-casa", ... },
  { id: "cap-depois", capitulo: "depois" }, { id: "depois-venezuela" }, { id: "depois-fiscais" }, { id: "depois-totalizacao" }, { id: "depois-politize" },
  { id: "cap-riscos", capitulo: "riscos" }, { id: "risco-pianista" }, { id: "risco-biometria" }, { id: "risco-urna-trocada" }, { id: "risco-horarios" }, { id: "risco-boca" }, { id: "risco-territorio" }, { id: "risco-fiscal-fica" },
```

Chapter cards are ordinary narrated scenes (`cap-*`, 4 to 6 s of narration: "Capítulo dois. export const REGISTRO = { abertura: { componente: Abertura }, "sopa-concha": { componente: SopaConcha, gatilhos: { panela: ["panela", 1.5], concha: ["concha", 4], datafolha: ["Datafolha", 12], quaest: ["Quaest", 19] }, midia: ["sopa_concha"] }, ... } satisfies Record<CenaId, CenaDef>;

`satisfies Record<CenaId, CenaDef>` makes typecheck fail when a scene in `ORDEM` lacks a component. `Video.tsx` does `const def = REGISTRO[cena.id as CenaId]; const g = resolverGatilhos(cena, def.gatilhos)` (sequential search like `Criterio.tsx` does with `indiceDa`, so later triggers search after earlier ones) and renders `<def.componente .../>`. `plano.ts` throws at import if `voz.json` ids differ from `ORDEM` (same message style as `cenaPorId`). `npm run verificar` = `node --experimental-strip-types src/verificar.ts` prints the duration, chapter spans and the gate verdict without bundling.

`HUD` becomes `HUD({ tag, capitulos })`: one segment per chapter (flex = chapter frames), label `CAPÍTULO 03 / 06 · DEPOIS DA URNA` (vertical: `03/06`), tag `MASTERCLASS · 2º TURNO · 25/10`.

## 3. Generated-media pipeline

`scripts/video-masterclass-midia.py` (stdlib `urllib` like the voice script; `google-genai` only for stills). Key reads `GEMINI_API_KEY` from `PNAD/.env` by line parsing (same pattern as `ambiente()`), never printed.

Manifest `video/masterclass/midia/manifesto.json`:

```json
{ "itens": [
  { "id": "sopa_panela", "tipo": "video", "motor": "veo", "modelo": "veo-3.1-fast-generate-preview",
    "prompt": "...", "negativo": "text, logos, watermark", "segundos": 8, "formatos": ["16x9", "9x16"], "som": false },
  { "id": "secao_vazia", "tipo": "imagem", "motor": "gemini", "modelo": "gemini-3-pro-image-preview",
    "prompt": "...", "formatos": ["16x9", "9x16"], "reserva": "mflux" }
] }
```

Items: sopa_panela, sopa_concha_pobre, sopa_concha_rica, sopa_mesa (Veo); fila_secao, urna_mesa, maos_boletim, fiscal_cadeira (Veo B-roll); stills: secao_vazia, boletim_porta, actas_venezuela_abstrato, bandeira_argentina_abstrata (Gemini, mflux fallback via `conda run -n diffusionkit mflux-generate-flux2 --model flux2-klein-9b --width 1360 --height 768`, then ffmpeg lanczos upscale; 9x16 via 768x1360).

Functions: `chave_de(item, formato) = sha256(json.dumps([prompt, negativo, segundos, modelo, formato]))[:12]`; `pendentes(manifesto, cache)`; `sondar()` (one 4 s 720p call; on HTTP 403/429 mentioning billing, marks `veo_indisponivel` in cache and switches every Veo item to `manual`); `gerar_veo(item, formato)` (start, poll 10 s, download, `normalizar`); `gerar_imagem_gemini(item, formato)` (call shape from `clawdbot/.../generate_image.py`: `client.models.generate_content(model, contents=prompt, config=GenerateContentConfig(response_modalities=["TEXT","IMAGE"], image_config=ImageConfig(image_size="2K", aspect_ratio="16:9")))`, then PIL save); `gerar_imagem_mflux`; `normalizar(origem, destino, formato)` = ffmpeg `-vf scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=1920:1080,fps=30 -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -an` (audio kept separately as `<id>_<fmt>.som.m4a` when `som: true`); `absorver_entrada()`; `escrever_midia_json()`.

Outputs: `public/midia/<id>_16x9.mp4|png`, `public/midia/<id>_9x16.mp4|png`; cache `midia/cache.json` `{ "<id>_<fmt>": { "chave", "origem": "veo|gemini|mflux|manual", "modelo", "gerado_em", "segundos" } }`; `src/dados/midia.json` `{ "<id>": { "tipo", "formatos": ["16x9","9x16"], "segundos" } }` for Remotion and pytest.

Manual drop-in (Gemini web app / CapCut Seedance): the user saves files as `midia/entrada/<id>_16x9.mp4` or `<id>_9x16.mp4` (any codec/size); `--faltando` prints each pending id with its prompt ready to paste; `absorver_entrada()` normalizes, writes the cache entry with `origem: "manual"` and the manifest's current `chave`, so the item stops being pending. If only 16x9 exists, `midia.json` lists only that format and `Clipe` center-crops it in portrait (explicit, visible degradation, no failure).

Remotion: `componentes/Clipe.tsx` = `<OffthreadVideo src={staticFile(...)} muted startFrom={0} style={{objectFit:"cover", width:"100%", height:"100%"}} />` wrapped in `<Loop durationInFrames={segundos*FPS}>` when the scene is longer than the clip, with a 12-frame cross-dissolve to a frozen `Still` of the last second rather than a hard loop (prop `fim: "congelar" | "repetir"`), and an optional dark gradient `veu` for caption contrast. `componentes/Still.tsx` = `<Img>` with Ken Burns (`escala 1.0 → 1.08`, pan vector prop) over `cena.frames`. Both read `midia.json` to pick the format and fall back.

## 4. Screen captures for the map chapter

`scripts/video-masterclass-capturas.py` (Playwright Python, sync API): starts `python3 -m http.server 4173 --directory docs` as a subprocess, blocks `googletagmanager.com` via `route`, waits `document.fonts.ready`, and executes takes from `video/masterclass/capturas/roteiro.json`:

```json
{ "tomadas": [
  { "id": "mapa_busca_rj", "pagina": "fiscais_mapa.html", "formatos": ["16x9", "9x16"],
    "passos": [

      { "acao": "digitar", "sel": "#f-zona", "texto": "233" },
      { "acao": "clicar", "sel": "#f-busca [type=submit]" },
      { "acao": "esperar_js", "js": "window.fiscaisMapa.estado.centro !== null" },
      { "acao": "still", "nome": "resultado" },
      { "acao": "ir", "hash": "#uf=RJ&zona=233&l=RJ-60011-233-1414&s=" },
      { "acao": "esperar_js", "js": "window.fiscaisMapa.estado.aberto === 'RJ-60011-233-1414'" },
      { "acao": "pausa", "ms": 2500 }, { "acao": "still", "nome": "ficha" },
      { "acao": "mover", "sel": ".leaflet-popup", "passos": 40 }, { "acao": "rolar", "sel": ".leaflet-popup-content", "dy": 400 }
    ] },
  { "id": "totalizacao_conferir", "pagina": "totalizacao.html", "formatos": ["9x16"],
    "passos": [ { "acao": "still", "nome": "pre_camera" }, { "acao": "arquivos", "sel": "#arquivo", "qr_de": "exemplos[0]" }, { "acao": "esperar_sel", "sel": "#tela-conferir:not([hidden])" }, { "acao": "still", "nome": "conferir" } ] },
  { "id": "politize_bangu", "pagina": "politizesuavizinhanca.html", "passos": [ { "acao": "ir", "hash": "#l=RJ-60011-233-1414" }, ... ] },
  { "id": "politize_game", "pagina": "politize_game.html", "passos": [ { "acao": "still", "nome": "inicio" } ] }
] }
```

Contexts: 16x9 = viewport 1920x1080, DSF 1; 9x16 = viewport 540x960, DSF 2, `record_video_size` 1080x1920 (this triggers the page's own mobile layout, which is the real phone UX). `record_video_dir=capturas/bruto/`; after `context.close()`, rename `page.video.path()` to `capturas/bruto/<id>_<fmt>.webm`, then ffmpeg to `public/midia/cap_<id>_<fmt>.mp4` (same `normalizar`), stills to `public/midia/cap_<id>_<nome>_<fmt>.png`. Also writes a `capturas/tempos.json` `{ "<id>_<fmt>": { "stills": { "ficha": 7.3 } } }` with the second each still was taken, so Remotion can cut from the recording to a still at a known time. QR step: `qrcode.make(texto)` per `qrbu[]` string to the scratch dir, `page.set_input_files("#arquivo", paths)`; BarcodeDetector absent in headless Chromium → the page loads zxing-wasm from the CDN (network required). Optional: chromium args `--use-fake-ui-for-media-stream --use-fake-device-for-media-stream` to show the camera state with a test pattern.

Cursor: recommend the Playwright-injected cursor (`page.add_init_script` injects a fixed 36 px SVG arrow div updated on `mousemove`; all moves use `page.mouse.move(x, y, steps=30)`), because it lands inside the recorded video with true timing. Remotion's `componentes/Cursor.tsx` is only used over stills (CEP typing moment, section-number zoom). Zoom animations are done in Remotion: `componentes/Clipe` accepts `foco: { quadro, x, y, escala }[]` keyframes (fractions of the frame) and interpolates `transform-origin`/`scale`, so the raw recordings stay unzoomed and reusable.

## 5. Audio

Narration: `video-masterclass-voz.py` = `video_voz.main(Projeto(...))`, same ElevenLabs v4 call, `previous_text/next_text`, outputs `public/voz/<id>.mp3`, `<id>.palavras.json`, `src/dados/voz.json`.

Music: three tracks, one per act, requested after `voz.json` exists because lengths depend on narration: `trilha_a` (abertura + sopa: curious, warm), `trilha_b` (urna + depois + riscos: tense analytic underscore), `trilha_c` (mapa + fecho: hopeful). `music_length_ms = span_ms + 12 000`, clamped to 600 000, `force_instrumental: true`, cached by (prompt, length) hash in `midia/cache.json` under `trilha_*`. Post-process with the existing `loudnorm I=-23` (no loop cut). `componentes/Trilha.tsx` renders one `<Audio>` per track inside a `<Sequence from={inicio - 2*FPS}>`, `volume={(f) => entrada(f) * saida(f) * ducking(f)}` with 2 s cross-fades at act boundaries and `ducking(f) = interpolate(NARRANDO smoothed over ±8 frames, [0,1], [0.22, 0.10])`. SFX unchanged (whoosh per scene, stamp/scan/blip per `sfx` entries in `registro.ts`, chime on chapter cards).

## 6. Charts, data schema, tests

`scripts/video-masterclass-dados.py` reads (with sha256 recorded): `docs/assets/reponderacao_urna_1t.json`, `docs/assets/reponderacao_pnad.json`, `data/outputs/tse_eleitorado_perfil_benchmark.json`, `analysis/apuracao_2026/dados/presidente.json`, `docs/assets/reponderacao_metodologias.json`, `docs/assets/fiscais_mapa/indice.json` + `uf/RJ.json` + `uf/SP.json`, `scripts/apuracao_logs/familias.py` (`NOME_CURTO`), `apuracao/public/geo/br_uf.geojson` (reuse `projetar/caminho_svg` by importing `video-fiscais-dados` with `importlib`). Output `video/masterclass/src/dados/masterclass.json`:

```json
{ "gerado_em": "...", "fontes": { "docs/assets/reponderacao_urna_1t.json": "sha256..." },
  "urna": { "flavio_pct": 47.027772, "lula_pct": 45.162768, "diferenca_pp": 1.87, "validos": 119300788, "secoes": 499248, "comparecimento_pct": 78.92 },
```

`riscos` texts come from `indice.json["logs"]["criterios"][codigo]` (`regra`, `limite`, `conferir`) plus `NOME_CURTO`; the "innocent explanation" pairs in the roteiro are prose, but each risk scene shows the data-derived `limite` text on screen.

Chart components in `src/graficos/`: `Eixo.tsx` (`escala(valor, [d0,d1], [p0,p1])`, ticks, zero line), `BarrasInstitutos.tsx` (13 horizontal rows: grey ghost bar = published error, teal bar = reweighted, red zero line, rows stagger in from a trigger frame; sorted by `n`), `Concha.tsx` (per institute: 3 band pairs, sample vs PNAD, with a ladle icon over the sample bar and the deviation chip), `PerfilTSE.tsx` (sex split bar + 5 age bands; no cross-tab exists in the TSE file, so no true pyramid: label it "sexo" and "idade" side by side), `PontosEfeitoCasa.tsx` (dot = `desvio_mediano`, thin line min to max, grouped by `direcao`, institutes shown by number).

`tests/test_video_masterclass.py` (skip when `masterclass.json` absent, like the fiscais test): `test_ordem_bate_com_o_roteiro` (regex `## id` vs regex on `ORDEM` in `src/ordem.ts`, chapter card ids `cap-*` present once per chapter); `test_dados_batem_com_as_fontes` (recompute `erro_resumo`, `concha_destaques`, `urna` from the source files); `test_roteiro_sem_travessao_sem_fraude_e_sem_algarismos` (`—` absent, `fraude` absent case-insensitively, no digits in narration lines); `test_numeros_do_roteiro_vem_dos_dados`: each scene block may carry `<!-- dado: concha_destaques.mais_pobre.desvio_pp = 13,1 -->` comments; the test resolves the path in `masterclass.json`, compares rounded value, and asserts the spelled-out form (`_extenso()` in the test, integers to 999 and "vírgula") appears in the block; `test_roteiro_cita_os_links` ("fiscais do PL ponto com ponto br", "brasil ponto arvor ponto co", "totalização", "politize"); `test_midia_do_registro_existe` (every `midia:` id in `registro.ts` by regex exists in `src/dados/midia.json`); `test_duracao` (sum `voz.json` segundos + 0.9·(n−1) + 3.0 in [690, 750] or [840, 930]; fail if in (750, 840)); `test_manifesto_de_voz_cobre_o_roteiro` (as before).

## 7. 9:16 strategy

`formato.tsx` gains `escala` (1 in wide, 0.92 in vertical for type; chart boxes compute from `largura`), and `t(px)` = `Math.round(px * escala)`. New layout primitives in `componentes/Palco.tsx`: `Palco` (absolute box between HUD and captions: top `m+110`, bottom `vertical ? altura*0.16+120 : 230`, so scenes stop hand-computing `topo/base`), `Lado` (`flex-direction: row` in wide, `column` in vertical, `proporcoes=[1,2]` mapped to `flex`), `Pilha` (always column, `gap` scaled). `Titulo/Texto/Chip` read `escala` from context so callers pass one size. Portrait-specific decisions: the 13-institute chart is naturally vertical (rows), it needs no redesign; `Concha` stacks institute panels; map captures use the native 9x16 mobile recording (not a crop); the building sheet is shown as the phone screenshot with Remotion zoom; `PontosEfeitoCasa` rotates to vertical dot columns. Captions keep the existing vertical rule (bottom 16 %).

## 8. Execution plan and subagent split

Phase 0, sequential (Opus, one session, ~half day): scaffold `video/masterclass` (copy, rename, `ordem.ts`, `capitulos.ts`, `registro.ts` with placeholder scenes that render the chapter title, HUD by chapter, `Palco/Lado/Pilha`, `Clipe/Still/Trilha`), `video-masterclass-dados.py` + `masterclass.json`, test file with skips, `video_voz.py` extraction. Gate: `npm run typecheck && npm run lint` in both projects, `pytest tests/test_video_fiscais.py tests/test_video_masterclass.py`.

Phase 1, parallel (four sessions):
- Sonnet A, roteiro: `roteiro/roteiro.md` in pt-BR using ids from `ordem.ts`, numbers only via `<!-- dado: -->` comments resolved against `masterclass.json`, budget 1 700 to 1 750 words for 12:00 at ~145 wpm (fallback budget 2 050 to 2 150 for 14:30), chapter-card lines, scene copy strings for cards (`src/textos.ts`), the AAPOR vocabulary paragraph, the cautious Milei/Venezuela paragraphs from `roteiro/fontes.md`.
- Haiku B, bookkeeping and sourcing: `roteiro/fontes.md` (URLs and one-line quotes for Venezuela 2024 actas, Argentina 2023 fiscales, AAPOR house effect definition, TSE rules for fiscais de partido), `midia/manifesto.json` skeleton (ids and formats), `capturas/roteiro.json` skeleton, `.gitignore`, README, copying sfx.
- Opus C, pipelines: `video-masterclass-midia.py` (run `--sondar` first; if billing blocks Veo, print the `--faltando` list for the user's browser workflow) and `video-masterclass-capturas.py`; run both; produce `midia.json`.
- Opus D, charts: the four `src/graficos` components against `masterclass.json`, verified with `node stills.mjs MasterclassWide <frames>` on a temporary scene.

Phase 2, sequential: Sonnet A finalizes roteiro → Opus runs `video-masterclass-voz.py` → `npm run verificar` duration gate (trim or extend roteiro, regenerate only changed scenes with `--so`) → music generation (needs chapter spans) → scene wiring in two parallel Opus sessions split by chapter (abertura/sopa/urna vs depois/riscos/mapa/fecho; `registro.ts` is the only shared file, merged last) → stills QA loop: Haiku renders `stills.mjs` for both compositions at every trigger frame ±10 and at caption frames, Sonnet reviews overlaps, truncation, and caption contrast (a small `qa/contraste.py` with Pillow measures mean luminance of the caption box area vs `#5fd3e6`/`#eef2ff`; require ratio ≥ 4.5).

Phase 3: `node navegador.mjs`, `npm run render` (expect 10 to 15 min per format with OffthreadVideo), ffprobe duration check, watch both outputs.

Final checklist: lint 0 in both projects; typecheck both; `pytest tests/test_video_fiscais.py tests/test_video_masterclass.py` green; duration gate; every `midia:` id present for both formats or consciously center-cropped; caption contrast report; no digits, no em dash, no "fraude" in roteiro; nothing committed until the user asks.

```ts
  { id: "cap-urna", capitulo: "urna" }, { id: "urna-resultado", ... }, { id: "urna-erro", ... }, { id: "urna-casa", ... },
  { id: "cap-depois", capitulo: "depois" }, { id: "depois-venezuela" }, { id: "depois-fiscais" }, { id: "depois-totalizacao" }, { id: "depois-politize" },
```

Chapter cards are ordinary narrated scenes (`cap-*`, 4 to 6 s of narration: "Capítulo dois. Publicado, reponderado, urna."), so the timing model (narration + 0.9 s RESPIRO, CAUDA at the end) is unchanged. `src/capitulos.ts`: `CAPITULOS: { id, numero, titulo, cor }[]` and `capituloDe(cenaId)`. `plano.ts` adds `CAPITULOS_PLANO` (inicio/frames per chapter, from `CENAS`) and a precomputed `NARRANDO: Uint8Array(TOTAL_FRAMES)` (1 when any palavra covers the frame, with 0.25 s padding), used by ducking.

`src/cenas/registro.ts`:

```ts
export type CenaProps = { cena: Cena; dados: Dados; g: Gatilhos };
export type Gatilhos = Record<string, number>;          // name -> frame (resolved)
export type CenaDef = {
  componente: React.FC<CenaProps>;
  gatilhos?: Record<string, [palavra: string, reservaSegundos: number]>;
  midia?: string[];       // ids in midia.json that this scene uses (checked by pytest)
  sfx?: { arquivo: string; gatilho?: string; volume?: number }[];
};
export const REGISTRO = { abertura: { componente: Abertura }, "sopa-concha": { componente: SopaConcha, gatilhos: { panela: ["panela", 1.5], concha: ["concha", 4], datafolha: ["Datafolha", 12], quaest: ["Quaest", 19] }, midia: ["sopa_concha"] }, ... } satisfies Record<CenaId, CenaDef>;
```

`satisfies Record<CenaId, CenaDef>` makes typecheck fail when a scene in `ORDEM` lacks a component. `Video.tsx` does `const def = REGISTRO[cena.id as CenaId]; const g = resolverGatilhos(cena, def.gatilhos)` (sequential search like `Criterio.tsx` does with `indiceDa`, so later triggers search after earlier ones) and renders `<def.componente .../>`. `plano.ts` throws at import if `voz.json` ids differ from `ORDEM` (same message style as `cenaPorId`). `npm run verificar` = `node --experimental-strip-types src/verificar.ts` prints the duration, chapter spans and the gate verdict without bundling.

`HUD` becomes `HUD({ tag, capitulos })`: one segment per chapter (flex = chapter frames), label `CAPÍTULO 03 / 06 · DEPOIS DA URNA` (vertical: `03/06`), tag `MASTERCLASS · 2º TURNO · 25/10`.

## 3. Generated-media pipeline

`scripts/video-masterclass-midia.py` (stdlib `urllib` like the voice script; `google-genai` only for stills). Key reads `GEMINI_API_KEY` from `PNAD/.env` by line parsing (same pattern as `ambiente()`), never printed.

Manifest `video/masterclass/midia/manifesto.json`:

```json
{ "itens": [
  { "id": "sopa_panela", "tipo": "video", "motor": "veo", "modelo": "veo-3.1-fast-generate-preview",
    "prompt": "...", "negativo": "text, logos, watermark", "segundos": 8, "formatos": ["16x9", "9x16"], "som": false },
  { "id": "secao_vazia", "tipo": "imagem", "motor": "gemini", "modelo": "gemini-3-pro-image-preview",
    "prompt": "...", "formatos": ["16x9", "9x16"], "reserva": "mflux" }
] }
```

Items: sopa_panela, sopa_concha_pobre, sopa_concha_rica, sopa_mesa (Veo); fila_secao, urna_mesa, maos_boletim, fiscal_cadeira (Veo B-roll); stills: secao_vazia, boletim_porta, actas_venezuela_abstrato, bandeira_argentina_abstrata (Gemini, mflux fallback via `conda run -n diffusionkit mflux-generate-flux2 --model flux2-klein-9b --width 1360 --height 768`, then ffmpeg lanczos upscale; 9x16 via 768x1360).

Functions: `chave_de(item, formato) = sha256(json.dumps([prompt, negativo, segundos, modelo, formato]))[:12]`; `pendentes(manifesto, cache)`; `sondar()` (one 4 s 720p call; on HTTP 403/429 mentioning billing, marks `veo_indisponivel` in cache and switches every Veo item to `manual`); `gerar_veo(item, formato)` (start, poll 10 s, download, `normalizar`); `gerar_imagem_gemini(item, formato)` (call shape from `clawdbot/.../generate_image.py`: `client.models.generate_content(model, contents=prompt, config=GenerateContentConfig(response_modalities=["TEXT","IMAGE"], image_config=ImageConfig(image_size="2K", aspect_ratio="16:9")))`, then PIL save); `gerar_imagem_mflux`; `normalizar(origem, destino, formato)` = ffmpeg `-vf scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=1920:1080,fps=30 -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -an` (audio kept separately as `<id>_<fmt>.som.m4a` when `som: true`); `absorver_entrada()`; `escrever_midia_json()`.

Outputs: `public/midia/<id>_16x9.mp4|png`, `public/midia/<id>_9x16.mp4|png`; cache `midia/cache.json` `{ "<id>_<fmt>": { "chave", "origem": "veo|gemini|mflux|manual", "modelo", "gerado_em", "segundos" } }`; `src/dados/midia.json` `{ "<id>": { "tipo", "formatos": ["16x9","9x16"], "segundos" } }` for Remotion and pytest.

Manual drop-in (Gemini web app / CapCut Seedance): the user saves files as `midia/entrada/<id>_16x9.mp4` or `<id>_9x16.mp4` (any codec/size); `--faltando` prints each pending id with its prompt ready to paste; `absorver_entrada()` normalizes, writes the cache entry with `origem: "manual"` and the manifest's current `chave`, so the item stops being pending. If only 16x9 exists, `midia.json` lists only that format and `Clipe` center-crops it in portrait (explicit, visible degradation, no failure).

Remotion: `componentes/Clipe.tsx` = `<OffthreadVideo src={staticFile(...)} muted startFrom={0} style={{objectFit:"cover", width:"100%", height:"100%"}} />` wrapped in `<Loop durationInFrames={segundos*FPS}>` when the scene is longer than the clip, with a 12-frame cross-dissolve to a frozen `Still` of the last second rather than a hard loop (prop `fim: "congelar" | "repetir"`), and an optional dark gradient `veu` for caption contrast. `componentes/Still.tsx` = `<Img>` with Ken Burns (`escala 1.0 → 1.08`, pan vector prop) over `cena.frames`. Contexts: 16x9 = viewport 1920x1080, DSF 1; 9x16 = viewport 540x960, DSF 2, `record_video_size` 1080x1920 (this triggers the page's own mobile layout, which is the real phone UX). `record_video_dir=capturas/bruto/`; after `context.close()`, rename `page.video.path()` to `capturas/bruto/<id>_<fmt>.webm`, then ffmpeg to `public/midia/cap_<id>_<fmt>.mp4` (same `normalizar`), stills to `public/midia/cap_<id>_<nome>_<fmt>.png`. Also writes a `capturas/tempos.json` `{ "<id>_<fmt>": { "stills": { "ficha": 7.3 } } }` with the second each still was taken, so Remotion can cut from the recording to a still at a known time. QR step: `qrcode.make(texto)` per `qrbu[]` string to the scratch dir, `page.set_input_files("#arquivo", paths)`; BarcodeDetector absent in headless Chromium → the page loads zxing-wasm from the CDN (network required). Optional: chromium args `--use-fake-ui-for-media-stream --use-fake-device-for-media-stream` to show the camera state with a test pattern.

Cursor: recommend the Playwright-injected cursor (`page.add_init_script` injects a fixed 36 px SVG arrow div updated on `mousemove`; all moves use `page.mouse.move(x, y, steps=30)`), because it lands inside the recorded video with true timing. Remotion's `componentes/Cursor.tsx` is only used over stills (CEP typing moment, section-number zoom). Zoom animations are done in Remotion: `componentes/Clipe` accepts `foco: { quadro, x, y, escala }[]` keyframes (fractions of the frame) and interpolates `transform-origin`/`scale`, so the raw recordings stay unzoomed and reusable.

## 5. Audio

Narration: `video-masterclass-voz.py` = `video_voz.main(Projeto(...))`, same ElevenLabs v4 call, `previous_text/next_text`, outputs `public/voz/<id>.mp3`, `<id>.palavras.json`, `src/dados/voz.json`.

Music: three tracks, one per act, requested after `voz.json` exists because lengths depend on narration: `trilha_a` (abertura + sopa: curious, warm), `trilha_b` (urna + depois + riscos: tense analytic underscore), `trilha_c` (mapa + fecho: hopeful). `music_length_ms = span_ms + 12 000`, clamped to 600 000, `force_instrumental: true`, cached by (prompt, length) hash in `midia/cache.json` under `trilha_*`. Post-process with the existing `loudnorm I=-23` (no loop cut). `componentes/Trilha.tsx` renders one `<Audio>` per track inside a `<Sequence from={inicio - 2*FPS}>`, `volume={(f) => entrada(f) * saida(f) * ducking(f)}` with 2 s cross-fades at act boundaries and `ducking(f) = interpolate(NARRANDO smoothed over ±8 frames, [0,1], [0.22, 0.10])`. SFX unchanged (whoosh per scene, stamp/scan/blip per `sfx` entries in `registro.ts`, chime on chapter cards).

Functions: `chave_de(item, formato) = sha256(json.dumps([prompt, negativo, segundos, modelo, formato]))[:12]`; `pendentes(manifesto, cache)`; `sondar()` (one 4 s 720p call; on HTTP 403/429 mentioning billing, marks `veo_indisponivel` in cache and switches every Veo item to `manual`); `gerar_veo(item, formato)` (start, poll 10 s, download, `normalizar`); `gerar_imagem_gemini(item, formato)` (call shape from `clawdbot/.../generate_image.py`: `client.models.generate_content(model, contents=prompt, config=GenerateContentConfig(response_modalities=["TEXT","IMAGE"], image_config=ImageConfig(image_size="2K", aspect_ratio="16:9")))`, then PIL save); `gerar_imagem_mflux`; `normalizar(origem, destino, formato)` = ffmpeg `-vf scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=1920:1080,fps=30 -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -an` (audio kept separately as `<id>_<fmt>.som.m4a` when `som: true`); `absorver_entrada()`; `escrever_midia_json()`.

Outputs: `public/midia/<id>_16x9.mp4|png`, `public/midia/<id>_9x16.mp4|png`; cache `midia/cache.json` `{ "<id>_<fmt>": { "chave", "origem": "veo|gemini|mflux|manual", "modelo", "gerado_em", "segundos" } }`; `src/dados/midia.json` `{ "<id>": { "tipo", "formatos": ["16x9","9x16"], "segundos" } }` for Remotion and pytest.

Manual drop-in (Gemini web app / CapCut Seedance): the user saves files as `midia/entrada/<id>_16x9.mp4` or `<id>_9x16.mp4` (any codec/size); `--faltando` prints each pending id with its prompt ready to paste; `absorver_entrada()` normalizes, writes the cache entry with `origem: "manual"` and the manifest's current `chave`, so the item stops being pending. If only 16x9 exists, `midia.json` lists only that format and `Clipe` center-crops it in portrait (explicit, visible degradation, no failure).

Remotion: `componentes/Clipe.tsx` = `<OffthreadVideo src={staticFile(...)} muted startFrom={0} style={{objectFit:"cover", width:"100%", height:"100%"}} />` wrapped in `<Loop durationInFrames={segundos*FPS}>` when the scene is longer than the clip, with a 12-frame cross-dissolve to a frozen `Still` of the last second rather than a hard loop (prop `fim: "congelar" | "repetir"`), and an optional dark gradient `veu` for caption contrast. `componentes/Still.tsx` = `<Img>` with Ken Burns (`escala 1.0 → 1.08`, pan vector prop) over `cena.frames`. Both read `midia.json` to pick the format and fall back.

## 7. 9:16 strategy

`formato.tsx` gains `escala` (1 in wide, 0.92 in vertical for type; chart boxes compute from `largura`), and `t(px)` = `Math.round(px * escala)`. New layout primitives in `componentes/Palco.tsx`: `Palco` (absolute box between HUD and captions: top `m+110`, bottom `vertical ? altura*0.16+120 : 230`, so scenes stop hand-computing `topo/base`), `Lado` (`flex-direction: row` in wide, `column` in vertical, `proporcoes=[1,2]` mapped to `flex`), `Pilha` (always column, `gap` scaled). `Titulo/Texto/Chip` read `escala` from context so callers pass one size. Portrait-specific decisions: the 13-institute chart is naturally vertical (rows), it needs no redesign; `Concha` stacks institute panels; map captures use the native 9x16 mobile recording (not a crop); the building sheet is shown as the phone screenshot with Remotion zoom; `PontosEfeitoCasa` rotates to vertical dot columns. Captions keep the existing vertical rule (bottom 16 %).

Gate: `npm run typecheck && npm run lint` in both projects, `pytest tests/test_video_fiscais.py tests/test_video_masterclass.py`.

Phase 1, parallel (four sessions):
- Sonnet A, roteiro: `roteiro/roteiro.md` in pt-BR using ids from `ordem.ts`, numbers only via `<!-- dado: -->` comments resolved against `masterclass.json`, budget 1 700 to 1 750 words for 12:00 at ~145 wpm (fallback budget 2 050 to 2 150 for 14:30), chapter-card lines, scene copy strings for cards (`src/textos.ts`), the AAPOR vocabulary paragraph, the cautious Milei/Venezuela paragraphs from `roteiro/fontes.md`.
- Haiku B, bookkeeping and sourcing: `roteiro/fontes.md` (URLs and one-line quotes for Venezuela 2024 actas, Argentina 2023 fiscales, AAPOR house effect definition, TSE rules for fiscais de partido), `midia/manifesto.json` skeleton (ids and formats), `capturas/roteiro.json` skeleton, `.gitignore`, README, copying sfx.

- Opus D, charts: the four `src/graficos` components against `masterclass.json`, verified with `node stills.mjs MasterclassWide <frames>` on a temporary scene.

Phase 2, sequential: Sonnet A finalizes roteiro → Opus runs `video-masterclass-voz.py` → `npm run verificar` duration gate (trim or extend roteiro, regenerate only changed scenes with `--so`) → music generation (needs chapter spans) → scene wiring in two parallel Opus sessions split by chapter (abertura/sopa/urna vs depois/riscos/mapa/fecho; `registro.ts` is the only shared file, merged last) → stills QA loop: Haiku renders `stills.mjs` for both compositions at every trigger frame ±10 and at caption frames, Sonnet reviews overlaps, truncation, and caption contrast (a small `qa/contraste.py` with Pillow measures mean luminance of the caption box area vs `#5fd3e6`/`#eef2ff`; require ratio ≥ 4.5).

Phase 3: `node navegador.mjs`, `npm run render` (expect 10 to 15 min per format with OffthreadVideo), ffprobe duration check, watch both outputs.

Final checklist: lint 0 in both projects; typecheck both; `pytest tests/test_video_fiscais.py tests/test_video_masterclass.py` green; duration gate; every `midia:` id present for both formats or consciously center-cropped; caption contrast report; no digits, no em dash, no "fraude" in roteiro; nothing committed until the user asks.

```json
    "prompt": "...", "formatos": ["16x9", "9x16"], "reserva": "mflux" }
```

Items: sopa_panela, sopa_concha_pobre, sopa_concha_rica, sopa_mesa (Veo); fila_secao, urna_mesa, maos_boletim, fiscal_cadeira (Veo B-roll); stills: secao_vazia, boletim_porta, actas_venezuela_abstrato, bandeira_argentina_abstrata (Gemini, mflux fallback via `conda run -n diffusionkit mflux-generate-flux2 --model flux2-klein-9b --width 1360 --height 768`, then ffmpeg lanczos upscale; 9x16 via 768x1360).

Functions: `chave_de(item, formato) = sha256(json.dumps([prompt, negativo, segundos, modelo, formato]))[:12]`; `pendentes(manifesto, cache)`; `sondar()` (one 4 s 720p call; on HTTP 403/429 mentioning billing, marks `veo_indisponivel` in cache and switches every Veo item to `manual`); `gerar_veo(item, formato)` (start, poll 10 s, download, `normalizar`); `gerar_imagem_gemini(item, formato)` (call shape from `clawdbot/.../generate_image.py`: `client.models.generate_content(model, contents=prompt, config=GenerateContentConfig(response_modalities=["TEXT","IMAGE"], image_config=ImageConfig(image_size="2K", aspect_ratio="16:9")))`, then PIL save); `gerar_imagem_mflux`; `normalizar(origem, destino, formato)` = ffmpeg `-vf scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=1920:1080,fps=30 -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -an` (audio kept separately as `<id>_<fmt>.som.m4a` when `som: true`); `absorver_entrada()`; `escrever_midia_json()`.

Outputs: `public/midia/<id>_16x9.mp4|png`, `public/midia/<id>_9x16.mp4|png`; cache `midia/cache.json` `{ "<id>_<fmt>": { "chave", "origem": "veo|gemini|mflux|manual", "modelo", "gerado_em", "segundos" } }`; `src/dados/midia.json` `{ "<id>": { "tipo", "formatos": ["16x9","9x16"], "segundos" } }` for Remotion and pytest.

Manual drop-in (Gemini web app / CapCut Seedance): the user saves files as `midia/entrada/<id>_16x9.mp4` or `<id>_9x16.mp4` (any codec/size); `--faltando` prints each pending id with its prompt ready to paste; `absorver_entrada()` normalizes, writes the cache entry with `origem: "manual"` and the manifest's current `chave`, so the item stops being pending. If only 16x9 exists, `midia.json` lists only that format and `Clipe` center-crops it in portrait (explicit, visible degradation, no failure).

Remotion: `componentes/Clipe.tsx` = `<OffthreadVideo src={staticFile(...)} muted startFrom={0} style={{objectFit:"cover", width:"100%", height:"100%"}} />` wrapped in `<Loop durationInFrames={segundos*FPS}>` when the scene is longer than the clip, with a 12-frame cross-dissolve to a frozen `Still` of the last second rather than a hard loop (prop `fim: "congelar" | "repetir"`), and an optional dark gradient `veu` for caption contrast. `componentes/Still.tsx` = `<Img>` with Ken Burns (`escala 1.0 → 1.08`, pan vector prop) over `cena.frames`. `formato.tsx` gains `escala` (1 in wide, 0.92 in vertical for type; chart boxes compute from `largura`), and `t(px)` = `Math.round(px * escala)`. New layout primitives in `componentes/Palco.tsx`: `Palco` (absolute box between HUD and captions: top `m+110`, bottom `vertical ? altura*0.16+120 : 230`, so scenes stop hand-computing `topo/base`), `Lado` (`flex-direction: row` in wide, `column` in vertical, `proporcoes=[1,2]` mapped to `flex`), `Pilha` (always column, `gap` scaled). `Titulo/Texto/Chip` read `escala` from context so callers pass one size. # Masterclass em vídeo: do 1º turno à fiscalização do 2º (16:9 e 9:16, 14 a 15 min)

## Contexto

O vídeo dos fiscais (09/10, `video/fiscais/`, 10 min) contou os 12 critérios. A masterclass conta a história inteira: a sopa e a concha (amostra × eleitorado), o que a urna revelou das pesquisas (publicado × reponderado × urna, efeito de casa), o que vem depois da urna (contagem pública, fiscais, totalização paralela por QR do BU, Politize), a aula de riscos com exemplos reais dos logs e do capítulo 13, o mapa de fiscais em uso, e o convite. Narração na voz do Leonardo (ElevenLabs v4), marca Arvor Intelligence, música por capítulo, efeitos novos, clipes ilustrativos gerados por IA, capturas reais das páginas.

Decisões do Leonardo (17/10): **14 a 15 min direto** (nunca 13), **só voz e marca**, clipes por **navegador** (Gemini, CapCut Seedance, Grok Imagine). Descoberta desta sessão: o `openclaw infer` local já tem `openai/gpt-image-2` e `google/gemini-3-pro-image-preview` (imagem) e `openai/sora-2`, `google/veo-3.1-*` (vídeo) configurados via a conta ChatGPT/Google do Leonardo. Plano: **tentar o CLI primeiro** (sem custo de API avulsa; `--sondar` com um clipe de 4 s), navegador como reserva com a mesma convenção de nomes.

Premissa corrigida pelos dados: o 1º turno foi **Flávio 47,03 × Lula 45,16** (`analysis/apuracao_2026/dados/presidente.json`); as 13 pesquisas publicadas erraram a diferença em **+3,55 pp** a favor de Lula, a reponderação por renda PNAD reduz para **2,43** (`docs/assets/reponderacao_urna_1t.json`).

## Arquitetura

Projeto novo `video/masterclass/`, cópia generalizada de `video/fiscais/` (fiscais continua intacto; seu teste segue passando). Reutilizados sem mudança: `tema.ts`, `componentes/{Caixa,Contador,Fundo,Mapa,util}`, `navegador.mjs`, `stills.mjs`, `remotion.config.ts`, `eslint.config.mjs`. Generalizados: `plano.ts` (+ capítulos, + vetor `NARRANDO` para ducking), `Video.tsx` (registro em vez de `switch`), `HUD.tsx` (barra por capítulo, tag "MASTERCLASS · 2º TURNO · 25/10"), `formato.tsx` (+ `escala`).

Arquivos novos (todos sob `video/masterclass/`):
- `src/ordem.ts` (lista `ORDEM` de `{id, capitulo}`; `CenaId` tipado), `src/capitulos.ts`, `src/cenas/registro.ts` (`REGISTRO satisfies Record<CenaId, CenaDef>` com `componente`, `gatilhos` palavra→reserva, `midia`, `sfx`; typecheck falha se faltar cena).
- `src/componentes/{Palco,Lado,Pilha,Clipe,Still,Cursor,Trilha,CartaoCapitulo}.tsx`. `Clipe` = `OffthreadVideo` mudo, `objectFit: cover`, `fim: "congelar" | "repetir"`, `foco[]` para zoom por keyframe; `Still` = Ken Burns; `Trilha` = uma faixa por capítulo com cross-fade 2 s e ducking pelo `NARRANDO`.
- `src/graficos/{Eixo,BarrasInstitutos,Concha,PerfilTSE,PontosEfeitoCasa,Sopa}.tsx`.
- `src/cenas/*.tsx` (um arquivo por capítulo), `src/tipos.ts`, `src/dados/{masterclass,voz,midia}.json` (gerados).
- `roteiro/roteiro.md` (um `## id` por cena, mesmo padrão), `roteiro/fontes.md`, `midia/manifesto.json`, `midia/cache.json`, `midia/entrada/` (drop-in manual), `capturas/roteiro.json`, `README.md`, `.gitignore` (+ `public/midia/`, `public/voz/`, `midia/entrada/`, `capturas/bruto/`).

Scripts novos em `scripts/`:
- `video_voz.py`: núcleo extraído de `video-fiscais-voz.py` (`cenas, limpar, pedido, palavras_do_alinhamento, gerar_cena, manifesto`) com um dataclass `Projeto`; `video-fiscais-voz.py` vira wrapper de 10 linhas. `video-masterclass-voz.py` chama o núcleo e acrescenta música por capítulo e o catálogo novo de efeitos.
- `video-masterclass-dados.py` → `src/dados/masterclass.json` (nada digitado à mão; SHA-256 das fontes).
- `video-masterclass-midia.py` → clipes e stills (CLI openclaw, cache por hash do prompt, `--faltando` imprime os prompts pendentes para o navegador, `absorver_entrada()` normaliza o que vier de `midia/entrada/`).
- `video-masterclass-capturas.py` → gravações Playwright das páginas.
- `tests/test_video_masterclass.py`.

## Roteiro: capítulos e cenas (alvo 14:30; 2.050 a 2.150 palavras a ~145 ppm)

Cartões de capítulo (`cap-*`) são cenas narradas de 4 a 6 s. Entre parênteses, segundos narrados.

**0 Abertura (35 s)**: `abertura` (contagem até dois milhões duzentos e vinte e cinco mil votos de diferença; 499.248 seções); `tese` ("o fiscal vê, anota e pede cópia; não muda resultado, protege o voto de todo mundo").

**1 A sopa (150 s)**: `cap-sopa`; `sopa-panela` (urna = sopa de 157,8 milhões; o TSE diz idade e sexo da panela: mulheres 52,8 %, 16–24 12,5 %… 60+ 23,3 %); `sopa-concha` (instituto = mão, concha = amostra; a concha precisa ter o gosto da panela); `sopa-regua` (PNADC 2025 visita 1, padrão-ouro de renda e escolaridade: até 2 SM 35,2 %, 2–5 39,3 %, 5–10 17,0 %, 10+ 8,5 %); `sopa-conchas-reais` (Datafolha 14/10 com 48,3 % até 2 SM, 13,1 pp mais pobre; Quaest 31,0 %, 4,2 pp mais rica; Atlas; cartão em reais nominais e PNAD 2024 como escolhas auditáveis); `sopa-moral` (ponderar por idade e sexo é fácil, por renda é onde a mão escolhe).

**2 Publicado × reponderado × urna (160 s)**: `cap-urna`; `urna-resultado` (placar, válidos, comparecimento 78,9 %); `urna-erro` (gráfico de 13 pontos: média +3,55, 10 de 13 a mais para Lula, 7 fora da margem; 2022 foi 3,92); `urna-reponderado` (slope: 3,55→2,43, 7 de 10 aproximaram; Datafolha +4,04→−1,07; Quaest afastou, dito com o mesmo destaque); `urna-efeito-casa` (vocabulário AAPOR: house effect = desvio sistemático de uma casa contra as demais no mesmo período; MDA +9,44, Datafolha +3,64, Gerp −6,55, Veritá −7,51; correlação efeito × erro 0,88; institutos por nome e número, hipótese declarada, não acusação); `urna-virada` ("erro de pesquisa não é erro de urna; mas a mão tem nome").

**3 Depois da urna (150 s)**: `cap-depois`; `depois-contagem-publica` (o futuro: contagem pública em cada seção, ata diante do público; Venezuela 2024 como "o que o público pôde ver": a máquina imprime a ata, testemunhas levam cópia, a oposição publicou as atas; fonte obrigatória, sem afirmar vencedor); `depois-fiscais` (fiscal de partido dos dois lados, Lei 9.504 art. 65/66/68 verificados, fiscaisdopl.com.br); `depois-totalizacao` (captura do app: ler os QR do BU, conferir, enviar; assinatura da urna conferida contra o certificado do TSE; sem login, sem CPF, nenhuma foto sai; prova transmissão e soma, não o interior da urna); `depois-politize` (UF + zona + seção → boletim da vizinhança e nível de fiscalização; o jogo da conversa em uma frase: 10 personagens, 14 cenas).

**4 Masterclass de riscos (220 s)**: `cap-riscos`; `risco-sinais` (499.176 logs lidos; bateria em 23 % é rotina; atenção 0 = 72.082, 1 = 87.896, 2 = 8.250, 3 = 1.918); `risco-pianista` (voto rápido demais: mesário pianista × fila cheia; a regra de rapidez não marcou ninguém; o que o fiscal confere: eleitor presente, título, assinatura no caderno); `risco-biometria` (5.918 seções com muita liberação sem digital: leitor com defeito × liberação indevida; AC Porto Acre z1 s621, também reinício, atenção 2; conferir: ata registra a falha? quem liberou?); `risco-urna-trocada` (496 trocadas; SP z1 s257 PUC reserva com 2 cargas; RS Marau z62 s15 Flávio 90,8 %; o log não guarda o motivo nem qual tecla falhou; a hipótese "tecla danificada para forçar nulo" é exatamente o que a ata tem de responder: motivo, hora, lacres, número da urna, teste das teclas na zerésima); `risco-horarios` (abertura atrasada MS Nova Andradina 11:14; encerramento MG São João das Missões 23:55 e AM Tabatinga 23:14; fila explica, senhas às 17h provam; o povo como fiscal do encerramento: quem vota por último vê o BU sair); `risco-boca-de-urna` (art. 39 §5, dentro e fora do prédio; cadeia de denúncia: presidente da mesa e ata → juiz eleitoral → MP Eleitoral → app Pardal; verificar); `risco-territorio` (facção, aldeia, garimpo: AP Oiapoque Aldeia Kumaruma risco alto por 5 motivos públicos; FUNAI, IBGE, ANM, Ipea, FBSP; quanto mais fiscais, melhor; violência política); `risco-conferir-arquivo` (atenção 3: BA Teixeira de Freitas z183 s175 contagem divergente, zerésima ausente, identidade não confirmada; pede conferência formal, não é prova); `risco-fiscal-fica` (fiscal nunca é posto para fora; direitos; cópia do BU; o que registra: mesário desatento, pianista, mal-intencionado, compra de voto, voto amedrontado; sobretudo, a integridade da seção).

**5 O mapa (120 s)**: `cap-mapa`; `mapa-busca` (captura: CEP, zona com UF, raio, cores dos níveis); `mapa-predio-rj` (EM Getúlio Vargas, Bangu, 21 seções, 5.321 aptos, risco médio, seções normais e uma de atenção 3: um fiscal para 21 seções é pouco); `mapa-predio-sp` (EE Amélia Kerr Nogueira, 27 seções, 4 níveis no mesmo prédio); `mapa-zoom` (zoom 15 mostra o número da seção; ficha → Politize → fiscaisdopl).

**6 Fecho (75 s)**: `cap-fecho`; `fecho-argentina` (Milei disse que faltaram fiscais no 1º turno de 2023 e a campanha recrutou fiscais para o balotaje; é a afirmação dele, sistema de cédula, fonte obrigatória, sem a palavra proibida); `fecho-chamada` (três frases da casa; fiscaisdopl.com.br, brasil.arvor.co/totalizacao, /politize; Arvor Intelligence).

Regras fixas: sem travessão, sem "fraude", números por extenso, uma CAIXA ALTA por bloco, uma tag a cada 2–3 frases, "eleitorado de X", atipicidade = prioridade de fiscalização. Cada número do roteiro vem com `<!-- dado: caminho.no.json = valor -->` conferido pelo teste.

## Mídia gerada

`midia/manifesto.json`: itens `{id, tipo: video|imagem, motor: openclaw|manual, modelo, prompt (inglês, sem rostos, sem cores partidárias, sem texto legível, sem logos), segundos, formatos: [16x9, 9x16], som}`. Lista inicial: `sopa_panela`, `sopa_concha_mergulha`, `sopa_concha_pobre`, `sopa_concha_rica`, `sopa_mesa_tse_pnad`, `fila_secao`, `urna_mesa_lacre`, `boletim_impressora`, `maos_boletim_porta`, `fiscal_cadeira`, `escola_bangu_aerea`, `rio_amazonia_escola`, `qr_celular`, `atas_mesa_lampada`, `cedulas_argentina_abstrato`; stills: `secao_vazia`, `boletim_porta`, `mapa_fundo_textura`.
